title: erro na hora de troca o tipo de Gemini ficado em carregado em infinito

triage_metadata.reasoning: The reporter provides actionable information detailing a bug where switching Gemini model types upon reaching a daily limit causes the CLI to stay stuck in an infinite loading state. Environment metadata (CLI v0.44.1, OS win32) and issue context are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Fixing the infinite loading state during model fallback involves managing asynchronous stream state, React/Ink UI responsiveness flags (isResponding), and promise handling across useQuotaAndFallback.ts, useGeminiStream.ts, and core fallback handling.

summary.problem: Switching to a fallback Gemini model upon reaching a daily/terminal quota limit causes the CLI UI to get stuck in an infinite loading state.
summary.root_cause: When a quota error occurs during streaming, handleFallback awaits user interaction with ProQuotaDialog. Accepting the recommended model fallback (retry_always) desynchronizes the streaming state in useGeminiStream and useQuotaAndFallback, leaving isResponding true indefinitely or preventing the retried stream from completing.
summary.context: Reported in CLI v0.44.1 on win32 when changing Gemini model after reaching daily quota limits during an interactive task.

steps: Inspect and update useQuotaAndFallback.ts to ensure handleProQuotaChoice cleanly resets isDialogPending and quota error flags when resolving fallback intents.

Update useGeminiStream.ts stream handling and error boundaries to ensure that retried stream attempts after model switching properly emit events and guarantee setIsResponding(false) on completion or failure.
Ensure packages/core/src/fallback/handler.ts correctly updates active model configuration when processIntent resolves retry_always without leaving unresolved promises.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When model fallback is selected during a quota error, the CLI should switch models and complete the request without remaining stuck in an infinite loading state.
verification_steps: Add test coverage in useQuotaAndFallback.test.ts simulating a terminal quota error where retry_always is chosen.
Verify that the fallback request resolves, quota flags reset, and pending dialog state is cleared.
Run unit tests using Vitest to ensure all fallback test cases pass.
